items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: After I'd let Kid Ori to band once with a mandolin

ctx.x: Red Allen has been to Europe with Dude Ori.

Oh, Kid Ori. Oh, yeah. After I'd let Kid Ori to band once with a mandolin, you know. And, you know, like taking a hot lead to bass and the guitar playing by itself. But I wasn't playing guitar then. I was playing mandolin. And the violin player couldn't go, so I wasn't playing. I was playing. And when they stopped, me and Eddie kept playing. And it sounds so good, that's just all of them take a hot now, you see. And they let the piano take a hot. Drum, guitar. And you know, each one of them take a hot, you know.
Ask him who was with Ed Ori.
